'''Micah''' was a [[Force-sensitive]] [[human]] who was hunted by the [[Galactic Empire]]. During the [[Imperial Era]], Micah and the children of a [[Unidentified village (Micah)|village]] were tested by the [[Galactic Empire]]. When the tests revealed clues to Micah's Force sensitivity, the Empire wanted to take him away. Thus, [[Micah's mother|mother]] and [[Micah's father|father]] fled the village, meeting a [[Unidentified traveler (Barriss Offee)|traveler]] who told them to find the healer [[Barriss Offee]]. Offee told them about how the [[Jedi]] used to train children with potential like Micah; however, those same talents were but now a curse. As the [[Fourth Sister]] approached, Offee told her [[Mohsenian]] and human assistants to escort Micah and his parents to her [[Starship|ship]] and escape the [[Star system|system]]. She told them a [[Barriss Offee's friend|friend]] would meet them at their rendezvous.<ref name="TOTE" />
